title: account.linked v1
description: An anonymous account signed in with an e-mail code.

anonymous_user_id.description: The anonymous account that signed in.

user_id.description: The account it became or was merged into.

anonymous_household_id.description: The anonymous account's household before linking.

merged.description: False: the anonymous account was upgraded in place (household_id = anonymous_household_id). True: it signed in to an existing account, its household's stock moved into that account's household and the anonymous household was deleted.
